metaDescription: Order custom wood badge ID holders in bulk. Perfect for a natural, professional look. Get a free quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Wood badge ID holders offer a warm, professional alternative to standard plastic or metal holders. The natural grain of wood makes each holder unique, ideal for companies wanting an eco-friendly, upscale look. Choose from laser-engraved logos or names for a sophisticated finish that stands out at conferences or daily use. These holders pair well with lanyards in earth tones or matching leather.
